content.short: ThreatSlayer provides enterprise-grade security and user incentives to share data for a safer online experience.
content.description: ThreatSlayer by Interlock is a browser extension that protects you in real time from scams, phishing, malware downloads, and web attacks using threat-detection AI. It plans to reward users for passively discovering threats in the future. Interlock describes Decentralized Security (DeSec) as a Web3-oriented approach to online protection, addressing risks that affect DeFi users while also tackling online threats that have persisted since the Internet’s early days.
content.meta: ThreatSlayer is a Web3 wallet tool. Discover ThreatSlayer and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
